name: Ovak Goldcloak
portraitDescription: Strong and imposing, with greyish skin and prominent lower canines (tusks). Built for strength and endurance. Wearing a simple tunic and apron, carrying a ring of keys or a tankard, looking hospitable and observant. The character is exceptionally attractive and a pleasure to look at, with elegant features. Key features: lower tusks, grey skin, muscular build, battle-scarred look.
